decisions.reason: The decision changes the placement of I2C series resistors relative to the ESP32-S3 pins, pull-ups, and devices; it does not change any GPIO assignment or compatibility rule.
The I2C series-resistor placement decision is unrelated to the battery connector's physical placement, orientation, spacing, or mounting-hole clearance.
The source decision concerns I2C signal conditioning and does not alter the standalone USB regulator, source selection, activation condition, or powered load.
Placing series resistors before the I2C pull-ups and devices does not change the interboard connector types, pinouts, or matching pin-order policy.
The I2C resistor-topology correction does not affect the AXP2101 USB, battery, VMID, or VSYS power paths.
The source decision specifies electrical placement of already-defined resistors and introduces no component sourcing, availability, compatibility, or cost change.
The matched term is incidental; an I2C series resistor is unrelated to the battery connector series, pitch, pinout, mounting type, or unresolved labeling.
The correction changes I2C signal-conditioning placement on the bus but does not change the sensor board's requirement to provide sensor connectors.
The source decision concerns I2C series resistors and does not alter the switched 5V rail, its GPIO control, pull-down, loads, or shutdown behavior.
Changing the schematic placement of the existing 22-ohm I2C series resistors does not necessarily alter BOM entries, part numbers, resistance values, or DNP status.
The I2C resistor-placement correction has no entailed effect on KiCad library portability or footprint resolution.
